acceptance.riskRationale: Prescribed independent qualification of a governance-critical, authority-bearing boundary at a frozen candidate; read-only against the subject, no production effect.
successConditions: Same configuration across restart and a separate process is accepted; every member perturbed independently (each F4 scalar, each other scalar incl. constructor tolerance, ObservationPolicy max age, ObservationPolicy tolerance, present vs explicitly absent, host profile digest, effective profile digest, scope, family set, each family contract version, schema revision, effective-policy digest) changes the digest and makes BOTH execute and pin-export refuse with authorization_binding_changed and a durable EffectTimeRefusal, destination untouched (builder expectation F3-A 1)
Unknown binding version, malformed member, digest != recomputation, wrong types (bool, float, str number, negative, huge) refuse (F3-A 2)
Missing member refuses unless the explicit legacy_cutoff rule applies; cutoff default 0; no wildcard accepted; negative/non-int/bool/huge cutoff handled by an explicit documented rule (F3-A 3)
A store generated by the unchanged prior binary executes below the cutoff as legacy and refuses at or past it; approval_commitment byte-identical (F3-A 4)

catalogue_digest, approval_commitment, RuntimeAuthorityProfile dump, published schemas, reason vocabulary, EffectivePolicySnapshot.identity_digest and r08-v1..v7 identities byte-identical to baseline; legacy reader fails closed on new records (F3-A 5)

The binding confers no authority and removes no other refusal (F3-A 6); recovery/crash-point and failed-attempt behavior (F3-A 7); qualifier-constructed negative controls (F3-A 8); limits stated honestly and any anti-rollback claim fails (F3-A 9)

PASS requires every criterion met with raw evidence at the frozen heads; FAIL on any real bypass, widened authority or changed commitment; BLOCKED when independence, environment or the pin cannot be established; each criterion is reported separately
negativeControls: Member-order shuffling, duplicate JSON keys, extra unknown members inside effective_configuration
Replayed member copied from another decision or scope; downgrade by deleting the member (record at/past cutoff)
Every single-member perturbation tested for BOTH execute and pin-export (the builder tests do not drive pin-export for every member)
More than one crash point around append_decision; a hold persists no binding
A claim of anti-rollback or tamper protection in any document must fail the criterion

acceptance.qualificationBoundary: Qualifies only the persisted effective-configuration binding of the frozen Control Plane head against the stated expectations and the qualifier's oracle; it is not Tier 1, not a security clearance and not release acceptance. Unsigned store, no anti-rollback, legacy_cutoff provenance, mixed-fleet legacy writers and masked host changes are documented limits, not guarantees.

clauses.requiredBehavior: Distinguish implementation inspection, independent qualification, competent certification and final integration; preserve independence wherever required.
clauses.prohibitedShortcut: Fit an oracle to implementation or substitute developer tests.
clauses.binding: Define and run the qualifier's own scope and oracle; the builder expectations are a minimum and are not the test selection; no developer test substitutes for a qualification case.

clauses.requiredBehavior: Retain consequential decision ancestry, rejected alternatives, objections, adverse findings and supersession where legitimately relevant, subject to privacy and retention limits.
clauses.prohibitedShortcut: Delete, relabel, overwrite or silently rescore failures.
clauses.binding: Keep every adverse result with its original raw output (including the 41 known environmental baseline failures and their causes); never rescore, relabel or edit a frozen oracle to obtain green.

clauses.requiredBehavior: Bind claims to exact source, configuration, governing context and transition evidence; reconstruct authoritative pathways when deterministic execution replay is impossible.
clauses.binding: Qualify only the frozen heads in Inputs; evidence from the pre-merge branch heads 5ffd0ae, 4adb84b, b8fbe95, a1de48c, 55488d2 is not transferred to main without a recorded identity argument.

clauses.requiredBehavior: Optimize authorization-to-independently-qualified outcome; distinguish lifecycle evidence.
clauses.prohibitedShortcut: Treat PR counts, green CI or documents as delivery or qualification.
clauses.binding: Report delivery state precisely (merged, developer-tested, independently qualified or not); green CI, documents and PR counts are never reported as qualification.

clauses.requiredBehavior: Separate contribution, inspection, qualification, certification and integration according to risk and governing independence requirements.
clauses.prohibitedShortcut: Self-certify generated work or treat nominal human involvement as sufficient authority.
clauses.binding: The qualifier must be separate from the implementation builder (Lead Builder and its workers); report contribution, inspection, qualification, certification and integration as separate roles; a builder-spawned reviewer is not independent.
